1. I will escalate to senior management today for the $5,000,000 emergency liquidity shortfall, with a hard confirmation deadline before June 16.
2. Nadia will ensure the $4,000,000 securities substitution is properly documented in the capital-policy register, since the ring-fenced buffer memo is not yet recorded there.
3. Victor will prepare the payment instruction for June 16 initiation, pending confirmation that the full $12,000,000 is available.

Does anyone have any concerns with this plan before I finalize it as our binding same-day release and execution plan?
